answer: An honest AI agent provides 1 unit of verified useful work to mint an identity, whereas 1,000 fakes must repeat the compute, incurring a 1,000-unit cost. A network verifier acts as a bridge between the task assignment and the ledger, ensuring no output is reused. At each dawn of a new block, the verifier calculates the delta of state transitions across all histories. Any inconsistency or invalid transition triggers a permanent identity ban with no refund. This mechanism assumes that computational tasks cannot be amortized.
